description: This Dart source file defines the AppEnv class, which manages loading environment variables from a .env file at application startup in a Flutter project. It provides methods to load environment variables, retrieve specific values, and handle errors during loading.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: A utility class responsible for loading environment variables from a .env file and providing access to these variables throughout the app.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the environment variables from the .env file. It allows multiple calls, skips loading if already initialized, and handles errors differently based on debug or release mode.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the environment variables, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key, returning a provided fallback if the key does not exist.
